description: QUICK CAPTURE (/log): dump a fragment about a tool the builder just signed up for and it lands, always. Never refuses — missing fields come back named so the rounds can ask later. Use this at the moment of signup; use log_tool_event when you have the full picture.

examples.captured_text: Welcome to Linear — your 14-day trial has started

category.description: the closed category list, if known

confidence.description: stated when the source said it; inferred when you worked it out

dedupe_key.description: message id when captured from mail — stops a re-found receipt double-counting

occurred_at.description: ISO date it really happened; defaults to now

price.description: {amount, currency, period}, as much of it as the fragment states

problem_solved.description: the job the tool was taken on for, if said

retroactive.description: true when backfilling; pair with occurred_at

tool_name.description: canonical lowercase name — the only required field

trial_ends.description: ISO date the trial converts, if stated

name: capture_tool_event
title: Quick Capture
